    theorem EFiniteCharacterizations.FamilyExtraction.Relation.exists_dependent_semibrick_below {R : Type u} [Ring R] [IsNoetherianRing R] [IsArtinianRing R] {A₀ B₀ : Family R} (hr : Relation A₀ B₀) :
    ∃ (s : Finset (CategoryTheory.Skeleton (FGModuleCat R))), IsSemibrick ↑s ∧ (∀ x ∈ s, ∃ (X : FGModuleCat R), CategoryTheory.toSkeleton X = x ∧ Below A₀ B₀ X) ∧ ¬LinearIndependent ℤ fun (x : ↥s) => GrothendieckGroup.of ((CategoryTheory.fromSkeleton (FGModuleCat R)).obj ↑x)
